# Phase 10 - signing, final verification and publish prep

What this phase does: turns the *unsigned* artifacts Phase 9 produced into
something a real user can install and a reviewer can accept - **without** putting
a signing key anywhere near an automated system, and **without** re-litigating
Phases 0-9.

The rules it implements, in one line each:

* **Signing is a human step.** The keystore is generated by the owner on a machine
  they control, never committed, never in CI, never in any chat. CI's job is to
  build the *unsigned* artifacts and gate them - see [docs/RELEASE.md](../docs/RELEASE.md).
* **The release *shape* gets tested, not assumed.** A `smoke` build type is the
  release configuration made runnable (same applicationId, same code shape,
  debuggable, signed with the public debug key), so the Phase 6 UI gates can run
  against release-shaped code without a release key in CI.
* **The artifact is verified, not the build log.** `check-apk.py` reads the APK/AAB
  bytes: applicationId, version, icon, permissions, native ABI split, embedded
  payload, debuggable flag, signature state.
* **Nothing ships that has not been named.** Every gate prints
  `P10_<ID> PASS|FAIL|SKIP :: detail`; the run's last line counts them and decides
  the exit status.

## Layout

| Path | What it is |
|---|---|
| `workflow/phase10-release.yml` | the CI pipeline template - **copy it to `.github/workflows/` by hand** (the automation's token cannot write there). It contains no signing material and fails if it ever gains any. |
| `scripts/30-static-checks.sh` | Phase 9's checks (unchanged) + the Phase 10 release invariants + the APK inspector's self-test |
| `scripts/check-release-invariants.py` | no key material in the tree; the published identity matches `versions.lock`; the store package exists and fits Play's limits; the installed workflow cannot sign |
| `scripts/check-apk.py` | reads a built APK/AAB: manifest (binary AXML or protobuf), signature presence + certificate id, native libs per ABI, embedded payload - with expectations on the command line |
| `scripts/test-check-apk.py` | the inspector's own test: encodes a binary AndroidManifest.xml, packs APK/AAB-shaped zips, and asserts the inspector reads them back - and FAILS a wrong expectation |
| `scripts/check-gradle-script.py` | static shape checks for `app/build.gradle.kts` (delimiter balance, define-before-use, the run-#6 packaging fix still present, the shell gates' anchored identity greps agree with the file) - the defects that cost CI runs 1, 2, 3 and 6 were all of this kind, and `app/src` scans do not cover the build script |
| `scripts/00-run-phase10.sh` | the orchestrator: static -> unit -> payload -> emulator -> debug UI gates -> smoke gates -> store screenshots -> unsigned release APK/AAB + inspection -> Phase 9 gates -> one summary |
| `scripts/50-smoke-gates.sh` | builds and gates the release-shaped build (`-PtestBuildType=smoke`) |
| `scripts/40-release-verify.sh` | builds the release APK/AAB, asserts they are UNSIGNED (CI rule), and inspects them byte-for-byte |
| `scripts/70-device-screenshots.sh` | real device screenshots via `adb screencap`, driven by the accessibility tree (no hardcoded coordinates) |
| `scripts/60-store-assets.sh` | validates the screenshots against Play's rules and installs them into `docs/store/screenshots/` |
| `check-release-invariants.py --require-store-assets` | the same strict answer as the listing checklist: 512 icon + 1024x500 graphic + at least two real screenshots. The pipeline runs it after the screenshot stage as `P10_STORE_ASSETS` |
| `scripts/sign-release-local.sh` | **the human signing step**, scripted: aligns, signs, verifies, prints the certificate fingerprint, and refuses a keystore inside the repository |
| `scripts/90-real-device-signed.sh` | verifies the **signed** build on a real arm64 phone through the UI (wake/unlock preflight, first run, the in-app file browser + storage panel, screenshots at every step, a live turn, non-root file visibility, footprint, crash/obfuscation sweep) and writes a verdict bundle with a `DIAGNOSIS.txt` whenever a step fails. Every wait matches a screen by its **content** (the app's tags AND its own words) and unreadable dumps are counted (gate `UI_DUMP`), because a harness that cannot see the screen must say so instead of reporting the app as broken. **Run this against a fake phone first** with `test-90-real-device.sh` - reading a 700-line driver is not running it |
| `scripts/test-90-real-device.sh` | **runs** the driver above against a fake `adb` (`test-90-fake-adb.py`, fixtures from `test-90-fixtures.py`), in seven scenarios: `happy` (every gate PASS/SKIP, exit 0, on the shared `Documents/OpenCode` root), `locked` (must be reported as a *lock*), `blank` (screenshot gate must fail), `tags-gone` (dumps carry the app's words but none of its tags **and the run must still pass** - the real first-run false FAIL), `shown-hidden` (the platform marks everything `shown="false"`; the run must still drive the app), `no-grant` (All files access refused: the visibility check must FAIL `SHARED_ROOT`), `dump-unusable` (uiautomator cannot dump: the run must be red for THAT reason, `UI_DUMP` FAIL, `--timeout-scale 0.02`). Runs in the CI pipeline (step 1b, verdict `P10_DRIVER_SELFTEST`); the shim's first two answers are also checked by `30-static-checks.sh` |
| `scripts/p10d-ui.py` | reads a uiautomator dump for that driver (tap targets by Compose test tag / resource id / text, disabled states, `shown` handling, `attrs` for "what attributes does this device emit", "what is on screen" diagnostics). A node the platform marks `shown="false"` never wins over a visible one, but is still returned as a last resort (flagged with exit code 4) - a device that marks its whole hierarchy that way must not become undrivable. Self-tested by `test-p10d-ui.py` |
| `scripts/p10d-png.py` | decides whether a screenshot is a real screen or a black/off/unpainted frame (the v1 driver counted files and could not tell). Prints the FULL path (a shortened one named a file that did not exist), and is self-tested by `test-p10d-png.py` |
| `scripts/92-workspace-visibility.sh` | can anything OTHER than the app read the agent's files? Non-root `adb shell` listing/reading of the project root at the path the **app reported** (`--root`), plus the v3 checks: the live root is not app-private (`PRIVATE_ROOT_NOT_LIVE`), it is on shared storage outside `Android/data` (`SHARED_ROOT`), the system Documents provider can return the folder (`DOCUMENTS_PROVIDER`), a shell write lands in the same real directory (`SHELL_WRITE`), and the baseline that `/data/data/<pkg>` is NOT readable. `--expect-content REGEX` says which marker counts as "the app wrote this"; a missing expected file is reported as SKIP with the file it read instead, not as a failed read |
| `scripts/93-workspace-gates.sh` | the Phase 7 isolation class (W1-W3) re-run against the new project root, plus the W4 storage-location gate, then the external visibility check above. It GRANTS All files access first (`appops set MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE allow`, no root) so the default `Documents/OpenCode` layout is what gets tested; `P10_WS_NO_GRANT=1` runs the same gates without it, which is how the fallback's honesty is checked |

## Running it

```bash
# CI (or any machine with the Android SDK + a bootable emulator):
bash phase10/scripts/00-run-phase10.sh

# locally, without a device, in seconds (this is what a push triggers first):
bash phase10/scripts/30-static-checks.sh

# the human path, on your own machine (docs/RELEASE.md has the full procedure):
bash phase10/scripts/sign-release-local.sh --apk <unsigned apk> --aab <aab> \
     --keystore ~/keys/upload-keystore.jks --alias upload
bash phase10/scripts/90-real-device-signed.sh --apk phase10/signing/app-release-signed.apk
```

Iteration knobs (never for a verdict run): `P10_GRADLE_ONLY=1` (also
`phase10/CI_GRADLE_ONLY` containing `1`), `P10_SKIP_SMOKE=1`,`P10D_SKIP_ARTIFACT=1`
(rehearsal only: skip the APK identity/signature inspection, recorded as SKIP so a
rehearsal can never be read as an artifact verdict),
`P10_SKIP_P9GATES=1`, `P10_SKIP_SHOTS=1`. The device script takes
`--skip-live`, `--timeout-scale N` and `--apk PATH`.

## Evidence

`phase10/out/evidence/` (committed to `docs/progress/phase10-evidence/` by the
orchestrator, uploaded as an artifact by the workflow):

* `GATES_SUMMARY.txt` - every verdict, and the line that decides the job status;
* `p10-lines.txt`, `p10-release-lines.txt` - the raw gate lines;
* `p10-smoke-apk.json` / `p10-release-apk.json` / `p10-release-aab.json` - the
  inspected artifacts, as data;
* `device-facts.txt`, `smoke-gates.log`, `release-verify.log`, `store-screenshots.txt`;
* `phase6/` - the Phase 6 UI-gate evidence for the debug run (F1-F4, U1-U8), and
  `smoke-ui/` - the same gates against the release-shaped build;
* `phase9/` - the Phase 9 gates re-run on the same device.
